title: Pure Diabellstar

allow.WANTED: Seeker of Sinful Spoils: Shared Sinful Spoils card that searches Diabellstar by name; the page's opening.
allow.Sinful Spoils of Betrayal - Silvera: Shared Sinful Spoils card that sends a Diabellstar to negate, and protects Diabellstar effects from the GY.
allow.Guilt of the Sinful Spoils: Shared Sinful Spoils card that only works while you control a Diabellstar Monster Card.
allow.Sinful Spoils of Doom - Rciela: Shared Sinful Spoils card built for a Level 7 or higher Spellcaster, which Diabellstar the Black Witch is.
allow.Sinful Spoils Subdual: Shared Sinful Spoils card: fetches the Level 7 and 8 Illusion witches, Diabellze the White Witch and the Original Sinkeeper.
allow.Sinful Spoils Sanctification: Shared Sinful Spoils card that revives a Diabell monster by name.
allow.Sinful Spoils of Slumber - Morrian: Shared Sinful Spoils card the Diabellze Illusions let you set again from the GY.
allow.Sinful Spoils Struggle: Shared Sinful Spoils card: Diabellstar's milling and setting fills the GY it counts.
allow.Susurrus of the Sinful Spoils: Shared Sinful Spoils card: swaps a Diabell Spellcaster or Illusion for one in the GY or banishment.

summary: The Diabell witches at full count, paired with the shared Sinful Spoils Spells and Traps that name or serve them and generic staples. Sending Spells and Traps from the hand or field fuels a cycle of Quick-Play searches, GY recursion, and field-wide protection.

summary.title: Starters
points: WANTED: Seeker of Sinful Spoils searches Diabellstar the Black Witch from the Deck or GY at Quick-Play speed, then banishes itself from the GY to bottom-deck a Sinful Spoils Spell/Trap and draw a card.
Diabellstar the Black Witch Special Summons itself from the hand by sending a card from the hand or field to the GY, then Sets any Sinful Spoils Spell/Trap directly from the Deck.
Diabellze the White Witch Special Summons itself by sending a Spell/Trap from the hand or field to the GY, then sends a Sinful Spoils or Diabell card from the Deck to the GY.
Sinful Spoils Subdual searches or Special Summons a Level 5 or higher Illusion monster—Diabellze the White Witch or Diabellze the Original Sinkeeper—from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: WANTED + Diabellstar the Black Witch
steps: Activate WANTED: Seeker of Sinful Spoils to search Diabellstar the Black Witch, then Special Summon Black Witch by sending a card from your hand or field to the GY.
Set Sinful Spoils Subdual or Sinful Spoils of Betrayal - Silvera directly from the Deck with Black Witch, then banish WANTED from the GY to recycle a Sinful Spoils card and draw 1.
Use Sinful Spoils Subdual or send a Spell/Trap from hand or field to summon Diabellze the White Witch or Diabellze the Original Sinkeeper alongside Black Witch.

summary.title: Bosses & Control: Two-Witch Protection
summary.text: While you control two or more Diabell monsters, Diabellze the White Witch prevents all monsters you control from being destroyed by the opponent's card effects. Diabellze the Original Sinkeeper Special Summons itself while a Sinful Spoils card is in either GY, forces the opponent to Set all Spells and Traps before activating them, and destroys a card on the field whenever a Set card is activated. Diabellstar Vengeance revives itself by banishing a Spell and a Trap from your field or GY and pays half your LP to destroy a card on either turn.

summary.title: Sinful Spoils Spells & Traps
points: Sinful Spoils of Betrayal - Silvera sends a Diabellstar from your hand or face-up field to the GY to negate a face-up card on the field, and banishes from the GY to stop an opponent's response to your Diabellstar or Sinful Spoils effects.
Sinful Spoils of Slumber - Morrian flips a Special Summoned monster face-down, and resets itself from the GY while you control a Level 5+ Illusion.

Guilt of the Sinful Spoils shuffles away a monster the opponent summons from the Deck or Extra Deck while you control a Diabellstar, and Sinful Spoils of Doom - Rciela shrinks and wipes opposing monsters.

Sinful Spoils Sanctification revives a Diabell monster from the GY or banishment, Susurrus of the Sinful Spoils swaps a witch on the field with one in the GY or banishment, and Sinful Spoils Struggle destroys cards up to your GY and banished Sinful Spoils count.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The Azamina Fusions and the White Forest Synchros have their own lists, and the page's Snake-Eye and Rescue-ACE partners are left out. The page's end board leads into Baronne de Fleur, which is Forbidden in the TCG, and Original Sinful Spoils - Snake-Eye is Forbidden as well.

exclude.Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils: Not yet released in the TCG.
exclude.Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Fore: Not yet released in the TCG.
